names.details:
[Ammā Baḥr-i Rūm]: Ammā Baḥr-i Rūm ki Ḫalīc-i Ḳosṭanṭıniyye’ye muttaṣıl olan deryādur. Kütüb-i ḳadīmede Baḥr-i Maġrib yāḫūd Baḥr-i Şām ismleri ile müsemmādur. Baḥr-i Muḥīṭ’dan çıḳar.

As for Baḥr-i Rūm: it is the sea connected to Golden Horn/Sea of Marmara?. In ancient books it is called the Sea of the West or the Sea of Syria/Damascus. It flows out from the Ocean. (Translated to English by the creator of this entry)

title: Internum Mare
provenance: Barrington Atlas: BAtlas 1 G4 Internum Mare
details: Also called Our Sea by Greeks and Romans, this is the entire body of water between the Straits of Gibraltar and the coast of Syria.
description: The Mediterranean Sea or Mare Nostrum is a sea connected to the Atlantic Ocean that is surrounded almost completely by land.
